Message:
rps: add CONFIG_RPS

RPS currently depends on SMP and SYSFS

Adding a CONFIG_RPS makes sense in case this requirement changes in the
future. This patch saves about 1500 bytes of kernel text in case SMP is
on but SYSFS is off.
